description: This file contains the implementation of a MongoDB connection pool listener that reports connection pool statistics to Kamon metrics system. It implements the ConnectionPoolListener interface from the MongoDB driver and tracks metrics such as pool size, checked-out connections, and wait queue size for each server.

classes.name: KamonConnectionPoolListener
classes.description: A listener for MongoDB connection pool events that reports metrics to Kamon. It tracks and updates gauges for pool size, checked-out count, and wait queue size per server.

methods.name: KamonConnectionPoolListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the listener with a specific metric name.

methods.name: connectionPoolOpened
methods.description: Handles the event when a connection pool is opened; initializes metrics for the server.

methods.name: connectionPoolClosed
methods.description: Handles the event when a connection pool is closed; removes metrics for the server.

methods.name: connectionCheckedOut
methods.description: Updates metrics when a connection is checked out from the pool.

methods.name: connectionCheckedIn
methods.description: Updates metrics when a connection is checked in to the pool.

methods.name: waitQueueEntered
methods.description: Increments wait queue size metric when a thread enters the wait queue.

methods.name: waitQueueExited
methods.description: Decrements wait queue size metric when a thread exits the wait queue.

methods.name: connectionAdded
methods.description: Increments pool size metric when a new connection is added.

methods.name: connectionRemoved
methods.description: Decrements pool size metric when a connection is removed.
